card.name: Digits inside dose amounts
card.fires_on: A single digit in the middle of a multi-digit dose number, just before mg, g or mL. It often falls inside totals or decimals such as 40.5, 1,080 or 33.75.

modes.label: Digit in a total
modes.description: A middle digit in a comma-separated total daily dose in mg.

modes.label: Digit in a decimal
modes.description: A digit in a decimal strength or dose, such as a gel percentage or gram amount.

card.plain: It fires on a digit in the middle of a dose number, such as the 8 in 1,080 mg.
